title: Italian Chocolate Babka
description: A sweet Italian dessert, this chocolate babka combines the rich flavors of Italian pastries with the decadence of chocolate.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine warm water and yeast. Let sit for 5-10 minutes until yeast is activated.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt.
Add yeast mixture to dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Add butter, eggs, and vanilla extract to dough and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead dough for 10-15 minutes until elastic and smooth.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down dough and roll out into a large rectangle.
Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval until smooth.
Spread melted chocolate over dough, leaving a 1-inch border around edges.
Roll dough into a tight log and cut into 12 equal pieces.
Place babka pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving 1 inch of space between each piece.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
